newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singtel denies seeking HK Telecom stake.
newsitem.headline: Singtel denies seeking HK Telecom stake.

text.p: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd denied market rumours on Friday it was seeking to buy a stake in Hong Kong Telecommunications from Britain's Cable & Wireless Plc.
"We've made very clear that we are not in any talks with them (C&W) to buy over Hongkong Tel," Ricardo Villaneuva, Singtel's corporate communications manager, told Reuters.
Hongkong Telecom shares rose sharply in Hong Kong on Friday on rumours that Singtel would be taking a stake in the company, brokers said.
Hongkong Telecom rose 5.5 percent to a high of HK$13.50 before dipped slightly to HK$13.25, up HK$0.45, just before the midday break.
Analysts said market talk that C&W would possibly sell part of its 59 percent stake in Hongkong Telecom to Singtel boosted sentiment.
A Hongkong Telecom spokeswoman said the company did not comment on market rumours.
Hongkong Telecom's American Depository Receipts closed 7.5 percent higher last night.
